Q: What is a typical characteristic of satellite internet?
Option1: Very low latency and short range
Option2: High latency due to long signal distance with wide coverage, useful in remote areas

Q: What is a Wireless Internet Service Provider (WISP)?
Option2: A provider offering fixed wireless access, often using unlicensed spectrum and directional antennas to deliver service to homes or businesses

Q: What is a Local Area Network (LAN)?
Option2: A network covering a limited area such as a home, office, or campus building

Q: What is a Wide Area Network (WAN)?
Option1: A network confined to a single room
Option2: A network that spans large geographic areas and interconnects Local Area Networks

Q: What is a Personal Area Network (PAN)?
Option1: A data center network for disks
Option2: A very short-range network for personal devices such as Bluetooth peripherals

Q: What is a Metropolitan Area Network (MAN)?
Option2: A network that spans a city or large campus using high-speed links

Q: What is a Storage Area Network (SAN)?
Option2: A high-speed specialized network providing block-level storage access to servers

Q: What is a Wireless Local Area Network (WLAN)?
Option1: A Wide Area Network with fiber links
Option2: A Local Area Network using Wi-Fi radio instead of or alongside cables

Q: A rural site lacks cable and fiber. Which connection type is often most practical?
Option1: Digital subscriber line at any distance
Option2: Satellite internet or Wireless Internet Service Provider if line-of-sight is available
